# Subway Seat for Dark Reader

Dark Reader takes only a background, a text colour and a selection colour, so this is just those, for both its dark and light schemes. Keys match Dark Reader's own setting names.

[Dark Reader](https://darkreader.org) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/dark-reader/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | Dark Reader → See all options → Colors |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.json`](subway-seat-tunnel.json) | Dark Reader → See all options → Colors |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.json`](subway-seat-enamel.json) | Dark Reader → See all options → Colors |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Dark Reader → See all options → Colors:

```text
Paste the values from subway-seat.json: background, text, selection
(set Selection from Automatic to Custom first).
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Dark Reader → See all options → Colors:

```text
Paste the values from subway-seat-tunnel.json: background, text, selection
(set Selection from Automatic to Custom first).
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Dark Reader → See all options → Colors:

```text
Paste the values from subway-seat-enamel.json: background, text, selection
(set Selection from Automatic to Custom first).
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
